tools.name: dicksonone_whoami
tools.description: Return the DicksonOne user that the API token belongs to. Good first call to confirm the connection. REST API: GET /api/rest/whoami.

tools.name: dicksonone_list_alerts
tools.description: List historical alerts for the account: a logger tripped a warning or excursion condition. Each alert has severity, type, excursion_at, returned_to_normal_at, acknowledged_at and its location, device and channel. Filter by logger, location, severity, type, active state or time window. Paginated. RES

tools.name: dicksonone_get_alert_summary
tools.description: Count active and cleared alerts, and alerts by severity (excursion, warning), for the account or for a filtered set. REST API: GET /api/rest/alerts/summary.

tools.name: dicksonone_list_alert_comments
tools.description: List the comments that users added to one alert, with author and time. Paginated. REST API: GET /api/rest/alerts/{alert_id}/comments.

tools.name: dicksonone_list_locations
tools.description: List the locations (sites, rooms, fridges) on the account, with their sublocation ids. Use the ids to filter alerts. Filter by name or by a list of ids. Paginated. REST API: GET /api/rest/locations.

tools.name: dicksonone_list_devices
tools.description: List the data loggers (devices) on the account. Each logger has a string token that stays the same across hardware replacements; use the token to filter alerts. Optionally filter by name and include archived or replaced loggers. Paginated. REST API: GET /api/rest/devices.

tools.name: dicksonone_acknowledge_alert
tools.description: Acknowledge one alert. The API sets the acknowledger to the user of the token and the time to the server time. An alert that is already acknowledged returns HTTP 409; the tool reports that as an error, and nothing changes. REST API: POST /api/rest/alerts/{alert_id}/acknowledgements.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: dicksonone_list_alert_comments · Private data: dicksonone_whoami, dicksonone_list_devices, dicksonone_acknowledge_alert · Public sink: dicksonone_acknowledge_alert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: dicksonone_list_alert_comments · Private data: dicksonone_whoami, dicksonone_list_devices, dicksonone_acknowledge_alert · Public sink: dicksonone_acknowledge_alert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
